title: Powder in a smoothie works
body: I open them into a morning smoothie. Consultant confirmed that is fine. Taste is barely there.

title: Better than the prescription did
body: I came off a bisphosphonate because of jaw worries. Two years of Plus and my numbers are slightly better than when I was on the drug. Four stars only because of the cost.

title: Followed up without being asked
body: Consultant called back two weeks after my first call to ask how I was getting on with the dose. Nobody does that any more.

title: No reply for a week
body: Sent an email about a double charge. Nothing for seven days. Then a reply asking for details I had already given. Sorted in the end but it should not be this hard.

title: Works, costs a fortune
body: Scan improved so I cannot complain about the product. I can complain about the price. Buying the six-month pack is the only way it is bearable.

title: Two years, both scans up
body: Both hip and spine improved over two years. My rheumatologist asked for the brand name.

title: Cancelled over cost
body: Loved the product. Could not afford the new price. Cancelled. Will miss it.

title: Capsules are huge
body: Four large capsules a day. I had a stroke and swallowing is hard. I open them into yogurt which works but is a nuisance.

title: Got a discount by asking
body: Called to cancel over the price and the consultant found me a better plan. Staying for now. It should not take a phone call though.

title: Upset stomach, could not finish bottle
body: Cramping after the evening dose. I am 80 and did not want to push through it. The return was handled quickly, I will say that.

title: Three scans, three improvements
body: 2022 -2.9, 2024 -2.5, 2026 -2.2. Same clinic, same machine. That is all I need to know.

title: No more heartburn
body: Switched from calcium carbonate which gave me heartburn every night. Gone. Whatever the algae does differently, my stomach approves.

title: Second scan held steady
body: First scan after a year was flat. I was annoyed, then my consultant pointed out flat is what we were hoping for at my age, 78. Fair enough.

title: Package stuck for two weeks
body: Tracking said it left the warehouse and then nothing for twelve days. I ran out. Support sent a replacement eventually but I missed almost two weeks of doses.

title: Took three emails to get an answer
body: Asked a simple question about taking it with thyroid medication. First two replies were generic. Third one was helpful. Should have been one.

title: Easy to pause
body: Paused for two months while I travelled. One email, done. Restarted on time.

title: Gentle
body: I have IBS and was nervous. No flare, no cramps. I take it with meals as advised.

title: Too expensive for what it is
body: Over eighty dollars a bottle. It is calcium from algae with vitamin D and K. I wanted it to be worth it. For me it is not.

title: Charged twice this month
body: Two charges on my card for one bottle. Still waiting for the second one to be refunded. The product is fine, the billing is not.

title: Not sure it is doing anything
body: No scan since I started, no way to know. Taking it on faith for now.

title: Arrived early
body: Ordered Monday, here Thursday. Nothing to add.

title: Felt like a sales call
body: Called with a question, left with a pitch for Strontium Boost and the six-month pack. I just wanted my question answered.

title: Cannot change delivery date online
body: Every month I have to email to move the delivery a week. The account page should let me do this.

title: Good advice, slow email
body: The advice was good when it came. Two days per reply is slow when you are worried.

title: Four a day is a lot to remember
body: Twice a day with meals. I forget the dinner dose at least twice a week. A once-daily option would suit me better.

title: Worse, and I did everything right
body: Took it exactly as directed for 18 months. Spine down 0.3. The guarantee process has started but I would rather have had the result.

title: Switched to Plus, got billed for both
body: Asked to switch from Basic to Plus and got billed for both one month. Fixed after a call, but annoying.

title: Hard to cancel
body: Could not find cancel in the account page. Had to email. Took two days. There should be a button.

title: Scan got worse
body: Took Basic for fourteen months. Spine down from -2.4 to -2.7. The consultant was kind on the phone and explained the guarantee, but I am still disappointed.

title: Consultant warned me about the scan reading
body: I called to ask why my scan jumped so much. The consultant explained that strontium changes how the machine reads bone and told me not to over-read the number. Honest answer, which I did not expect.

title: Mild stomach upset that passed
body: First ten days my stomach grumbled. Then it settled and now I notice nothing. Would have given five if the box had warned me it can take a while.

title: Delivery to UK took a month
body: A month to the UK plus a customs charge I was not warned about. The product is fine, the journey was not.

title: Guarantee was harder than the ad made it sound
body: My scan was worse and I asked for the money back. They wanted the before and after scans on the same machine, and mine were at two clinics. Took three calls. I did eventually get it but I would not call it easy.

title: Could not swallow them
body: Tried for a week. Gagged every time. My daughter opens them for me now. Not the product's fault entirely but a smaller pill would help a lot of us.

title: Bloating
body: Bloated and uncomfortable from day three. Stopped after the first bottle. Customer service offered tips about splitting the dose but it did not help me.

title: Too soon to tell
body: Six months in. No scan yet so I cannot say if it works. No side effects at all, swallowing is fine. Will update after the DEXA in January.

title: Finally a calcium I can tolerate
body: Every other calcium gave me constipation within a week. Three months on this and nothing. I take two with breakfast and two with dinner as the box says.

title: Not for people on a pension
body: I am sure it is good. It is also priced for people who are not me. Cancelled after two bottles.

title: Real human on the first ring
body: Phone answered by a person on the first ring who knew the product. I am not used to that.

title: Lost in the post, slow replacement
body: First order never arrived. Took a week of emails to get a replacement sent. Second one came fine. Not a good first impression.

title: Mixed scan
body: Spine better, hip slightly worse. The consultant said that happens. I do not know what to think so three stars until the next one.

title: Small improvement at the hip
body: Hip went from -2.1 to -1.9, spine the same as before. Not dramatic but it is the right direction. Four stars because it took a full year and the price adds up.

title: No constipation at all
body: Switched from a supermarket calcium because of constipation. Problem solved on day one.

title: Kidney stone worry
body: I have had kidney stones and my urologist was not keen on more calcium. The consultant said to talk to my doctor rather than giving me an answer. I appreciated that but I still do not know if I should take it.

title: Box crushed
body: Box arrived crushed, one bottle cracked. Replacement sent. Pack them better.

title: Same as before
body: Twelve months, same reading. Keeping going one more year because stable is better than falling, but I am not thrilled.

title: Wrong item sent
body: Ordered the Bone Builder Pack, got collagen. They fixed it but I had to pay return shipping first and claim it back.

title: No change, cancelling
body: A year on Basic. Same T-score to the decimal. I am cancelling the subscription. The product may work for others, it did not for me.

title: Expected more after the testimonials
body: The stories on the site are all big jumps. Mine was -2.5 to -2.4 after 18 months. Maybe that is realistic but the marketing sets you up for more.

title: Osteopenia to normal at the hip
body: Hip went from -1.3 to -0.9 at 63. I am in the normal range for the first time since I was tested.

title: Too many pills with everything else
body: With my other medications I am up to eleven pills a day. Adding four more was the tipping point. Went down to two a day and I know that is not the full dose.

title: Reminder email went to spam
body: Got charged for a renewal I forgot about. The reminder was in my spam folder. Not entirely their fault but a text would help.

title: Big, but manageable with a drink
body: They are large. With a full glass of water they go down. Would love a smaller capsule even if it meant more of them.

title: Best customer service I have dealt with
body: Email answered the same day, by a person who clearly read what I wrote. I have cancelled subscriptions over worse service than this. Staying.

title: Reliable monthly delivery
body: Subscription box shows up like clockwork every month. Only wish the delivery date were adjustable from the account page.

title: Buy on sale or not at all
body: I only reorder when there is a sale. Full price is out of reach. Works though.

title: Smell
body: Capsules have a seaweed smell when you open the bottle. Fine once swallowed. Just a heads up.

title: Worth it, barely
body: It is doing what it says. I just wish I did not have to choose between this and other things each month.

title: Three bottles I did not order
body: Somehow my subscription was set to three bottles a month. Charged for all three. Refund took two weeks.

title: Constipation unless I drink a lot
body: Works out if I drink two extra glasses of water. Forget the water and I pay for it. Three stars because it needs managing.

title: -3.1 to -2.6
body: Spine -3.1 to -2.6 in 20 months. Also take vitamin K2 and walk daily so I cannot give all the credit to one bottle, but I am not stopping.

title: Reading went up, then my doctor explained why
body: My scan jumped a whole point and I was thrilled, then my endocrinologist told me strontium inflates the reading. I feel misled. The website should say this more clearly.

title: Modest gain, no side effects
body: -2.3 to -2.1 after a year. Not huge. But no drug side effects either, which is why I am here.

title: Helpful but scripted at first
body: First call felt like reading from a card. Once I pushed back she dropped the script and was genuinely helpful. Four stars.

title: Shipping on top of the price
body: Eighty something for the bottle and then shipping on top unless you buy more. The total surprised me at checkout.

title: Renewed after I cancelled
body: Cancelled in September, charged in October. They refunded it, but I had to notice it first. Check your statements.

title: Price is the only complaint
body: Product good. Service good. Price not good.

title: Skipping a month is easy by email
body: Needed to skip a month. One email, sorted the same day. Would prefer to do it myself online.

title: Told me to check with my doctor
body: Asked about Strontium Boost with a heart condition. Consultant would not give medical advice and told me to ask my cardiologist. Correct answer. Respect for that.

title: Another increase
body: Just saw the new price at renewal. That is three increases since I started. Cancelling today.

title: Fast to Ontario
body: Four days to Ontario. Box was fine. The customs form was correct which has not been my experience with other US supplements.

title: Bottle arrived with a broken seal
body: Outer box was fine, inner seal was broken. They replaced it without fuss. Three stars because it should not happen.

title: Nothing changed in two years
body: Two years, every capsule, and my scan is exactly where it was. I am glad it did not get worse but that is a lot of money for exactly the same number.

title: Costs more than my prescription did
body: My old prescription was covered. This is not. I understand why it is not, but the gap is a lot and it keeps growing.

title: Forearm scan improved
body: Had a forearm DEXA because of a hip replacement. Improved from -2.6 to -2.2. The consultant actually knew what a forearm scan was, which my pharmacist did not.

title: Easy on the stomach, hard on the wallet
body: Zero digestive issues, which for me is remarkable. Docking a star for the price, which is the only thing about it that hurts.

title: Pricey but I trust it
body: I do not love paying this much. I do trust the company more than the cheap brands. Three stars is where those two feelings meet.

title: T-score moved for the first time in years
body: My DEXA in March was -2.8 at the spine. Eighteen months on Plus and Strontium Boost and it read -2.3. My doctor asked what I had changed. I had not expected to write a review for a supplement but here we are.

title: Price increase email was the last straw
body: Got the email about the new price the same week my pension did not go up. Cancelled. I may come back if there is ever a real sale.

title: Doctor was surprised
body: Went from osteoporosis range to osteopenia range at the hip after a year and a half. My GP does not believe in supplements and even she said keep doing whatever you are doing.

title: Price went up again
body: Second increase in a year. I am on a fixed income. I believe in the product but I cannot keep absorbing this. Looking at alternatives.

title: Debit card charged, overdraft fee
body: They say do not use a debit card and now I know why. Renewal hit before my pension and I got an overdraft fee. That is on me partly, but the warning is buried.

title: Six-month pack is the only sane option
body: Monthly price is wild. Six-month pack is bearable. Why not just make the monthly price fair?

title: Cannot justify the latest increase
body: Been a customer four years. The product has not changed. The price has, twice. I feel like loyalty counts for nothing.

title: Took a month to settle
body: Stomach complained for the first month. Now fine. Hang in there if you can.

title: Nausea every morning
body: Felt sick within half an hour of the morning dose for two weeks running. Tried with food, tried less, no difference. Returned the rest. Your stomach may differ.

title: Price increase with no explanation
body: The email just said prices are changing. No reason. For a company that talks about trust, that felt thin.

title: Expensive add-on
body: Plus is already dear and then they tell you that you really need Strontium Boost too. Together it is more than my electricity bill.

title: Raised the price, kept the shipping fee
body: Raise the price fine, but then at least include shipping. Both together is too much.

title: Take them with dinner and they are fine
body: Large but fine with a meal. Empty stomach is a mistake, learn from me.

title: Unaffordable now
body: Cannot do it any more at the new price. Three years a customer. Sorry.

title: Nice people, long wait
body: Phone wait was twenty minutes. The person was lovely. The wait was not.

title: Why did my price change
body: My renewal went up without me noticing until the card statement. Yes there was an email, no I did not read it. The jump was still unwelcome.

title: The consultant actually listened
body: I called in tears after a bad scan. The consultant spent half an hour with me, did not push product, and told me to see my doctor about one thing I mentioned. That is rare.

title: Fine for me
body: Reading the other reviews I expected horse pills. They are large but no worse than my fish oil. No trouble.

title: Great product, wrong price
body: If this cost half as much I would give it five stars and buy it for my sister. At this price I am not even sure I can keep buying it for me.

title: Reasonable only in bulk
body: Monthly price is steep. The six-month pack brings it down enough that I kept going. Would not buy one bottle at a time again.

title: Refund for the double charge came quickly
body: Double charged, emailed, refunded in three days with an apology. Mistakes happen, this was handled well.

title: Subscription just works
body: Eighteen months, never a billing problem, never a missed delivery. Boring in a good way.

title: Stable, which for me is a win
body: I am 71. My scans had dropped every two years since menopause. The last one was unchanged from the one before. Unchanged is the best news I have had from that machine.

title: Metallic taste
body: Odd metallic taste for an hour after each dose. Not unbearable, but enough that I dread it. Two stars.

title: Headaches
body: Started getting headaches a week into Strontium Boost. Stopped, they went. Started again, they came back. Stopped for good. Plus on its own is fine.

title: Patient with my questions
body: I asked a lot of questions about the research. The consultant answered what she could and sent links for the rest. Did not pretend to know what she did not.

title: Subscribe and Save is not much of a save
body: Ten percent off when the base price is this high is not a saving, it is a rounding error. Cancelling and buying the bulk pack when there is a sale.
